Distribution This species has an Indo-Pacific distribution. It has been recorded in South Africa from Cape Province to East London (Mortensen 1933), the Indonesian region (Döderlein 1927) and Flinders Islands (Bass Strait, Australia) (Clark 1916); its bathymetric range extends from 182 (Clark 1916) to 860 m (Clark & Courtman-Stock 1976).
